annotations.text:
24 x 36 in portrait (2304 x 3456 px at 96 px/inch).
Carleton does not publish a size for the Showcase; that lives in the
I-CUREUS Brightspace course, or ask icureus@carleton.ca.
Body type is 26px = ~19.5pt.

Three placeholders left to fill:
[SUPERVISOR] in the byline, [QR CODE] top right, [REPO URL] in the footer.
Everything else is a measured number from the run.

Written for a general Showcase audience: first person, plain language,
no em dashes, no conference framing. Syne 800 for the title,
Space Grotesk for body, JetBrains Mono for every number.
